Label: has location
Definition: a relation between a phenotype and an anatomical entity, where the anatomical entity is the location of the phenotype.

Label: uses assistive equipment
Definition: a relation between a human and an device, where the device is an assistive equipment used by the human in order to move or to accomplish something, such as a task or an activity.

Label: is assessed by
Definition: a relation between a human and an evaluation procedure, where the human is assessed by an evaluation procedure, such as a test, a questionnaire or a scale.

Label: affects
Definition: Describes an entity that has an effect on the state or quality of another existing entity.

Label: affected by
Definition: describes an entity of which the state or quality is affected by another existing entity.

Label: related to
Definition: A relationship that is asserted between two named things
